supporting_observations.claim: The domain controller recorded creation of ext.rwong at 13:44:07 UTC by nora.blake, shortly after the alert's approximate time.
The account-creation event uses the same logon ID as an earlier network logon for nora.blake from WS-NBLAKE-01, supporting attribution to her account and workstation.
The new account was added to the Freelancers group. The ext.<name> naming pattern and this group membership align with the organization's stated help-desk process for temporary accounts.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs for the proxy host were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC due to an outage, so proxy activity during that interval cannot be assessed. This interval overlaps the account-creation activity.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish whether ext.rwong was requested or approved for a specific business purpose.
The evidence does not establish whether nora.blake's session or credentials were compromised.
The supplied records do not establish the account's complete group memberships or permissions beyond the recorded Freelancers addition.
unrelated_findings: Cisco AnyConnect's UI was launched on WS-NBLAKE-01, although the inventory says the organization has no VPN. The records show the UI and a valid Cisco-signed module, but do not establish that a VPN connection was made; assess separately.
